function: Learns satellite transmit power control (discretized levels) for inter-satellite and ground links, trading task offloading latency, battery energy and dropped tasks; service migration is rule-based (p. 8).
system: 11 LEO satellites, one orbit plane, 784 km, 50 users; ISL K-band 20 GHz, ground link L-band 1.6 GHz; antenna gains only, no array or RIS (pp. 3-4, 9).
method: Reinforcement learning: centralized PPO with MLP and multi-agent MAPPO with RNN (centralized training, decentralized execution), Stable-Baselines3; action is a discretized power level (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: Simulation only: Shannon rate with free-space path-loss link budgets and Iridium-based parameters, stochastic energy-harvesting packets; no 3GPP NTN model, dataset or measurement (pp. 3-4, 9-10).
test_conditions: Models trained independently in the simulator (400 slots); evaluated over time slots and at 100 and 400 total slots; no unseen scenario, constellation or load tested (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Non-learned: never migration (NM), particle swarm optimization (PSO), unlimited-resource bound (UR, solved from P2); learned: A2C with the same training setting as SpaceEdge-PPO (p. 10).
metrics: Average user latency, remaining battery energy and successful offloading ratio over time slots; training reward curves (pp. 10-11).
q1_support: p. 3: "the channel gain considering free space path loss" in a Shannon-rate link budget, with parameters of an Iridium-like constellation (p. 10); no 3GPP TR 38.811 model, dataset or measurement is used.
q2_support: p. 10: "we independently train SpaceEdge-PPO and SpaceEdge-MAPPO"; p. 11: "Increasing the length of the simulation has no effect on our model" only changes the horizon (100 versus 400 slots) of the same simulator; no unseen scenario, constellation, user number or adaptation is tested.
q3_support: p. 10: "Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm (PSO)" and Never Migration are non-learned baselines, and "Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C): This is a policy-based DRL algorithm" is the standard learned baseline; p. 11: "SpaceEdgePPO preserves more energy in the battery than A2C" compares performance.
q4_support: p. 9: "training hyperparameters of both DRL models in Table II" are listed, but no complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime of SpaceEdge is reported anywhere in the paper.
q5_support: p. 9: "Our algorithm and network architecture are implemented using the Stable-Baseline3 framework" on a custom simulator; no link to its own code or data is given and no public dataset is used.
notes: Included because learned transmit-power control of satellite links is physical layer: p. 8: "action in DRL model can be reduced to focus on power control", while service migration follows fixed rules (Section III-C), so the reviewer may confirm the above_phy check. Area 6. Tables I and II (p. 9) and Figs. 4 to 7 (pp. 10-11) were read from page images.
